title: ID0466689-DC/Si-D/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839009] Issue in CP1 of the charger

Following your report, we can see that the problem is related to one charging session, which ended with the plug was stuck in the EV. Please note that all charging sessions that end this way are caused by an issue on the EV side, not the charger.

Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
